metaDescription: Kevin riffs on Peter Thiel and JD Vance, arguing a powerful figure would rather control politicians than hold office himself.
summary: Kevin reacts to a clip about not wanting to run for office. He argues that powerful people prefer to control politicians rather than be one, referencing the idea that Peter Thiel groomed JD Vance for the vice presidency. He concludes such a person wants to be a puppet master, not a puppet.
